name: oust-own-token
class: removal spent on its own permanent
why: Oust's only targets are its own two Rogue tokens: a card and a 2/2 for 3 life.

name: snapcaster-sorcery-speed
class: a flash creature cast at sorcery speed
why: Its last 2 mana leaves the flashback unpayable; at the human's end step it does the same and dodges Winds of Abandon.

name: spare-jace-wielder
class: an attack that leaves a lethal planeswalker alive
why: The human is tapped out with no creatures; Snapcaster Mage and the Spirit deal exactly Jace, Wielder's 3 loyalty, the card that later decks the agent.

name: decline-mana-crypt
why: The Crypt costs nothing to take: the library is shuffled either way and a card in hand need never be cast.

name: evoke-subtlety-no-target
class: an evoked creature whose enters ability has no target
why: The stack is empty: Subtlety's trigger targets only a creature or planeswalker spell, so evoking it spends two cards on nothing.

name: spirits-stay-home
why: The human has no creatures and no untapped answer that punishes two tapped 1/1 fliers.

name: samurai-into-jace
class: an instant-speed planeswalker ability spent at once
why: The Samurai made now sits in front of the resolving Jace's -1; made at the human's end step it dodges it.

name: staff-in-upkeep
class: an optional instant-speed activation that spends interaction mana early
why: Spending its only untapped white source turns off Reprieve for the human's whole turn. It can draw at the end step if it still has the mana.

name: staff-before-combat-damage
class: an optional instant-speed activation that spends interaction mana early
why: Nothing in its deck can use the remaining white mana to affect combat. Waiting preserves the option to exile Subtlety with Winds of Abandon in its second main.

name: jace-loots-before-draw
class: optional activation before gaining draw-step information
why: The draw gives another card to consider before deciding whether to loot and what to discard.

name: discard-emperor-over-spare-crypt
class: useful spell discarded instead of surplus mana
why: At 4 life with ample mana and a Mana Crypt already in play, discard the spare Mana Crypt rather than a castable Emperor that can supply a blocker.

name: decline-second-teferi-untap
why: Teferi has untapped only one land; another own tapped Island is available at no cost, with No More Lies and Reprieve in hand.

name: evoke-subtlety-empty-stack-hunt
class: an evoked creature whose enters ability has no target
why: The stack is empty: evoking Subtlety pitches Abhorrent Oculus and then sacrifices Subtlety without a creature or planeswalker spell to affect.

name: subtlety-main-phase-empty-stack
class: a flash creature cast at sorcery speed
why: Passing preserves Reprieve and Subtlety interaction; casting in the opposing end step gives the same next-turn attack without exposing the body to sorcery-speed removal.

name: skip-teferi-plus-one
class: a free beneficial loyalty activation skipped
why: The final main-phase pass skips an available Teferi +1: a card, loyalty and delayed land untaps at no mana cost, with 23 library cards and no visible draw penalty.
